description: Declared mutants of the JSON Module batch (docs/architecture/target/v2/json-module-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 8.6; ids js-). Written step by step with the tests; the whole catalog goes to an adversarial check (Fable/high) at step 7. Not added (with the reason): the empty-text check before yyjson (equivalent: yyjson reports empty input as an error at offset 0 too); reading in place (YYJSON_READ_INSITU) and a move that does not empty its source (undefined behaviour without a sanitizer: not a reliable mutant); the std::bad_alloc catch in Parse (no injection point for the adapter's own allocations).

mutants.what: J-3: numbers are converted by yyjson instead of handed over as raw text
J-2: a repeated key in a small object (pairwise path) is not found
mutants.cases: Parse: a key repeated in one object*

mutants.what: J-2: a repeated key in a large object (hash path) is not found
mutants.cases: Parse: repeated keys are found in large objects*

mutants.what: J-2, J-9: objects inside containers are not walked, so their repeated keys pass
mutants.cases: Parse: a key repeated in one object*

mutants.what: J-2 detail: '~' in a key is not escaped as ~0 in the JSON Pointer
5.5: the column restarts at the newline itself instead of after it
5.5, J-9: yyjson's allocation failure is reported as Syntax, not OutOfMemory
5.2: WrongKind names the found kind as the expected one
J-9: the array walk steps to the next node instead of the next sibling (enters nested containers)
mutants.cases: ObjectView and ArrayView: walking steps over nested*

mutants.what: J-9: the object walk skips a fixed two nodes instead of the value's whole subtree
mutants.cases: ObjectView and ArrayView: walking steps over nested*
